config.paper_weight_provenance: 2024 active weights retained; Eq7=.05, Eq16=.1, NPS=.01 are declared unverified author coefficients
config.paper_nps_sampling: Both checkerboard parities; four axial one-pixel neighbors; omit image-edge neighbors; Euclidean nearest-static-pixel-center distance; sum, not mean.
config.paper_opacity_domain: full raw-alpha MSE against binary Md; coefficient100 inherited control

assumptions: First vehicle up defines local vertical; low-tilt ground required.
Hd is the union of actor time-aggregated LiDAR AABBs in the first vehicle frame; extends vertically to fitted ground.
Ground support includes a3m XY margin around actor support;0.5m grid10th-percentile lower envelope; deterministic256trial RANSAC and least-squares.
SGCM executes after optimizer on an offset schedule avoiding generic densification;20px radius is the undeclared projected-footprint threshold choice.
Resource cap limits additions per step; large projected footprints prioritized.
Clone copies parameters; split uses symmetric two-child largest-axis moment-matched spatial subdivision and unchanged temporal fields.

addition_guard.projection: Camera row-vector world_view/full_proj; center NDC x,y in [-1,1]
addition_guard.semantics: training-view support proxy; no occlusion or exact per-Gaussian contribution
addition_guard.clone_limit: one SGCM clone per initial source lineage; all descendants inherit spent state
addition_guard.split_children: both proposed children need support in at least one training view
addition_guard.checkpoint: legacy 18-field capture tuple; optional optimizer.sgcm_lineage_v1 payload
